messages:
nina_marketing: Quick sync - "Spring Benchmarks" virtual event on Tue 11am PT. Goal: 400 registrants, 220 live attendees. Need final reg page, Zoom webinar setup (panelists + practice), captioning/ASR plan, HubSpot mapping + SDR routing, and post-event asset cadence. Owners?

jorge_ops: I can handle Zoom webinar config + practice session. Propose: Zoom Webinar (not meeting) so we get Q&A + panelist controls. Will schedule panelist practice 48h before event.

emma_content: Ill own registration page copy + asset folder. Reg page must capture: email, first/last, company, role, use_case (radio), opt-in marketing, GDPR consent (checkbox). Hidden fields: utm_source, utm_campaign=spring_benchmarks_2026.

chris_sales: Ill own lead routing. Preference: on-submit -> create contact + assign lead_score + tag `event:spring_benchmarks`. For attendees, set property `event_attended=true` and trigger workflow to SDR pool `SDR_events`. No-shows get a 48h nurture sequence.

nina_marketing: Nice. Reg page must include calendar .ics link and timezone selector (auto-detect). Also add a quick 2-question pre-event survey (priority topics + current infra). Keep form short.

jorge_ops: Zoom settings draft:
- Type: Webinar (license: zoom-webinar-12)
- Panelists: host + 4 (loading order to avoid mute issues)
- Practice session: enabled, 30m before
- Q&A: enabled (allow attendees to upvote)
- Chat: attendees -> panelists only
- Closed captioning: enable manual + auto-transcription (cloud)
- Cloud recording: enabled (separate audio tracks for panelists)
- Auto-delete after 45 days (we'll archive copy locally)
- Registration required: off (we use our own reg page)
- Branding: webinar logo + title in top-left

emma_content: HubSpot form mapping for engineers: 
```js
form.fields = ["email","first_name","last_name","company","role","use_case","pre_survey","utm_source","utm_campaign"]
form.hidden = {"lead_source":"spring_benchmarks_2026"}
```
Also add `consent_to_contact=true/false` boolean and map to GDPR property.

chris_sales: Routing specifics:
- On form submit -> add `event:registered:spring_benchmarks` tag
- If Zoom webhook event `attended` fired -> set `event_attended=true`, add tag `event:attended` and notify `SDR_events` Slack channel
- If webinar watch_time > 15 min -> increment lead_score + create task for SDR to prioritize within 48h

jorge_ops: Recording + transcripts flow:
1) Cloud recording -> auto-transcribe (Zoom CC)
2) Export VTT + MP4 to drive.redwood/events/spring_benchmarks/2876543210
3) Run internal ASR to generate improved transcript + SRTs
4) Derive 3 x 90s social clips using highlights timestamps (team to mark in Sheet during event)

emma_content: Post-event cadence:
- T+4h: Send thank-you email to registrants with on-demand link + 3 key takeaways + CTA (book a demo).
- T+48h: Attendees: personalized follow-up with related content; No-shows: N-1 nurture with short highlights clip + replay CTA.
- T+7d: Publish trimmed 8-10min highlights + full transcript on site; push clips to LinkedIn/Twitter.
- T+14d: SDR intensive outreach to top engaged leads.

nina_marketing: Analytics / benchmark metrics to capture: registrations, live attendance rate, avg watch time, clip completion rate, MQLs from event, demos booked within 14d, demo->signup conversion. Compare to Q4 webinar baseline.

chris_sales: Small automation note: Zoom webhook sometimes duplicates `registrant.join` events if attendees reload. We'll dedupe by zoom_registrant_id before updating HubSpot.

jorge_ops: Zoombot: scheduling + retention policy deployed?

zoombot: automated: Webinar `spring-benchmarks-2876543210` created (id: wz-2876543210). Practice session scheduled 48h prior. Cloud recording retention set to 45 days.

emma_content: Owners + deadlines:
- emma_content: final reg page + copy by Fri EOD
- jorge_ops: webinar config + practice script by Mon EOD
- chris_sales: HubSpot workflows + dedupe rules by Mon EOD
- nina_marketing: email templates + social clip brief by Mon EOD
If anyone needs help with mapping or wording ping me or drop drafts here. :sparkles:
